params.body:
## What

**The asked card waits for the voice.** When the model asks a question it also sends `veld`, and the matching card (Waar, Hoe laat, ...) lit up straight away. The tool call arrives before the audio, so at the start of a call the screen showed "Werven" before anything had been said. `conversation.js` now holds the card until `output_audio_buffer.started`. If that event never comes it falls back after 4 seconds, and it drops the card when the worker starts speaking.

**The role is background, not the flow.** Each role used to come with its own way of asking (a driver: "per werf of rit apart"; a crane operator: machine hours first), and the opening asked "waar heb je vandaag gewerkt?". But one person can fill several roles in a day, for example site work in the morning and driving between sites in the afternoon. So:
- the opening asks "wat heb je vandaag allemaal gedaan?";
- the prompt says the profile is background only: first ask openly about the whole day, then go through it part by part and ask only what each part is missing;
- the details that depend on the role still apply, but only when that part of the day comes up: plate and km reading when he drove, machine hours kept apart from his own hours when he was on the crane.

## Tests

- `PersonaTest`: every role gets the open first question and the background sentence, and none of them asks "waar heb je vandaag gewerkt?" any more.
- JS: the card shows when the question is heard, not when it is noted.
- Full suite: PHP 306 passed, JS 16 passed.
